name: Streaming Text
hint: Flip Raw / Smoothed to replay the same bursty stream both ways; scroll up mid-answer to release the auto-follow.
description: The assistant's message body for chat and copilot products. Incoming chunks are buffered and released word by word at an even, time-based pace that speeds up when the buffer grows and eases off as it drains, never showing half a word. The newest words enter slightly tinted and low and settle to ink over 600ms, so the eye finds the write head without a blinking cursor. Markdown is recognised as it streams: paragraphs, lists, a table whose columns are reserved from its header, a code block that grows line by line and enables its copy button when it closes, inline code, links and citations. Half-arrived syntax never flashes. It auto-scrolls only while you are at the bottom, offers Jump to latest with a count of new lines, and carries Stop, Skip to end, Copy, Regenerate and Retry. The wait for the first token is its own designed state, and a screen reader hears whole sentences from one polite live region.
intents: stream an AI assistant response token by token
render streaming markdown from an LLM without layout jumps
chat message body with stop, retry and regenerate
smooth out bursty streamed text from a model
AI answer with citations, tables and code blocks
usage: Use it as the assistant turn of a chat. Pass the message so far as `text` and your request state as `status` (submitted, streaming, ready, error: the AI SDK's `useChat` vocabulary); the component never changes `status` itself. Wire `onStop` to your stop(), `onRetry` and `onRegenerate` to your reload(); they only report, a new answer arrives when you pass new `text`. Or hand it `stream`: an async iterable of strings or a ReadableStream of text or bytes, and it tracks the state itself. Name the assistant with `assistant` ({ name, role, context, icon }); `question` shows the user's turn above it, `sources` ([{ id, title, detail }]) back the [^1] citations, `pending` ({ label, rows }) is the wait before the first token. Smoothing releases whole words at `speed` words per second; turn it off to render chunks as they land. Content is markdown: paragraphs, - and 1. lists, pipe tables, fenced code, `inline code`, [links](url) and [^1] citations. Set `height` for the built-in scrolling card, or `height={0}` to follow the nearest scrolling ancestor (or pass `scroller`). A screen reader hears whole sentences from one polite live region; under reduced motion text arrives a line at a time with no per-word effect. With no props it renders an empty root and nothing else. The sample finance answer and its Raw / Smoothed demo bar appear only with `demo`.

dataProps.description: The assistant's message so far (markdown). Pass the whole text each time it grows; a text that does not start with the previous one restarts the message.
Request state, owned by the caller. submitted shows the wait before the first token; error shows what arrived plus Retry. Can be passed without `text`.
Alternative to text/status: a stream of text chunks (strings or bytes). The component reads it and tracks its own state; Stop cancels it.
Who is answering. name defaults to "Assistant"; icon is a ReactNode for the 26px mark (null hides it).
The user's turn shown above the answer. Empty shows none.
A finished answer to show without streaming (static use). Ignored when text or stream is passed.
Sources matched against [^id] citations in the text; cited ones are listed under the answer.
The wait before the first token: a label (default "Thinking") and optional [name, figure] rows that are ticked off.
Override any fixed word: waiting, writing, answered, stopped, interrupted, starting, stop, skip, regenerate, retry.
Height of the built-in scrolling card in px; 0 drops the card and follows the nearest scrolling ancestor.
The scrolling element to follow while the answer grows, when it is not the nearest scrolling ancestor.
Disables Stop, Skip, Copy, Regenerate, Retry and the citation buttons.
() => void, when Stop is pressed. The message shows what arrived as stopped; cancel your request here.
() => void, when Retry is pressed after an error or stop. Start the request again and pass the new text.
() => void, when Regenerate is pressed on a finished answer.
() => void, when Skip to end shows everything already received at once.
(text) => void, once the last word has been revealed after the source finished.
(id, source | null) => void, when a citation is pressed (the matching source also flashes).
